subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 5: A Letter to a Teacher (Writing)
lesson: Error correction and planning with notes (Top Tip)
outcomes: Correct capital letters, apostrophes and spelling in a letter
Plan a letter with key-word notes under four headings
Use formal language to draft a letter to a teacher

tf.s: Notes should be written in complete sentences.
tf.why: Notes are key words, not complete sentences.
It is used in formal letters.

tf.s: 'Dear…' and 'Best wishes' can be used in both formal and informal letters.
tf.why: These two work in both kinds of letter.

tf.s: We use formal language in this letter because it is for a teacher.
tf.why: A letter to a teacher needs a formal style.

tf.s: One of the four headings for notes is 'spare time'.
tf.why: The headings are family, spare time, future plans and learning English.

tf.s: 'Love from' is a good ending for a formal letter.
Planning before writing helps you organise your ideas.
tf.why: Notes help you remember and order your ideas.

boxes.q: 'I am week at Maths.' 'Week' should be...

boxes.why: 'I would like to…' is polite and formal.

boxes.q: Which is NOT one of the four headings?
boxes.why: The headings are family, spare time, future plans and learning English.
Key words are quick and clear.

boxes.q: Which is the best formal opening sentence?
o: I am writing to introduce myself to you.

boxes.q: What comes last in the letter plan?
boxes.why: A letter ends with a conclusion.

mcq.q: Which four things must students write about?
o: Family, spare time, future plans and learning English

mcq.q: Which two expressions can be used in both formal and informal letters?
mcq.why: They fit both kinds of letter.

mcq.q: Why do we use formal language in this letter?
o: It is addressed to a teacher
It is to a best friend
mcq.why: We write formally to a teacher.

mcq.q: How should the letter be organised?
o: Introduction, family, spare time, plans, learning English, conclusion
mcq.why: Each part gets its own paragraph.

mcq.q: Correct: 'im from salalah and i dont like english'
o: I'm from Salalah and I don't like English.
Im from Salalah and I dont like English.
I'm from salalah and i don't like english.
I'm From Salalah And I Don't Like English.
mcq.why: Capitals, apostrophes and a full stop are needed.

mcq.q: Which is the best key-word note for the heading 'spare time'?
o: I really enjoy playing football with my friends every Friday afternoon.
mcq.why: Notes use key words, not full sentences.

mcq.q: Which sentence is too informal for a letter to a teacher?
o: I am writing to introduce myself.
I would like to tell you about my family.
I hope to improve my English.

mcq.q: Why should you plan before writing?
o: Notes help you remember ideas and organise the writing
Planning means you don't need to write
mcq.why: A plan gives your letter a clear order.

mcq.q: Why are key words better than full sentences in notes?
o: They are quick to write and easy to read
mcq.why: Notes are only reminders of your ideas.

mcq.q: Why is it helpful to correct one type of mistake at a time?
o: It helps you focus and find more mistakes
There is only one mistake in a letter
mcq.why: Looking for one thing at a time is easier.
